title: Corn Milk
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 tbsp. rock sugar ( ,optional if you prefer a healthier version)
ldInstructionsRaw: Cut the corns off the cob. And place it in a blender. Add water and milk and blend until smooth.
Strain the liquid if you want a smooth version. Transfer the strained liquid into a small pot, add sugar and simmer to a boiling. The drink becomes thick itself since the corn fluids contains starch.
